title: Cactus Bounce A-Z
hook: Desert life makes every cool place count.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: cheerful 3D cactus-and-dune storybook, coral green and warm sand palette, rounded forms, simple background

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child comparing how desert plants, animals, rocks and water sources respond differently to heat and dryness
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: contrast sun, shade and water without making one adaptation fit every target
creativeFingerprint.grooveMeter: gentle 6/8 heat-shimmer sway with cool half-time pockets
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written adaptation scenes; heat and water language is specific and never universalized
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: sun/shade/water cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe cooling/shape gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Verses stay sparse; chorus widens; retrieval strips back. dry shaker footsteps and sparse marimba echoes with open space
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: dry shaker footsteps and sparse marimba echoes with open space
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Teach desert life through the daily negotiation between heat, shade and scarce water: bodies, burrows, ears, thick tissues and timing matter more than a cartoon cactus bounce.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child notices hot/cool contrast and water-saving adaptations; recurring language uses sun, shade, store, wait, burrow, evening, cool ground and one precious drop.
semanticArc: animals seek shade or safer timing
oasis and plants show where water matters
forbiddenGenericLanguage: dunes and desert look with me
